name: content-extract
title_zh: 把被墙或杂乱的网页一键抽成干净 Markdown
tagline_zh: 公众号文章、被反爬的页面，web_fetch 抓不动时它先探路再换 MinerU 兜底，最后给你带来源链接的可追溯。
tagline_en: When web_fetch chokes on WeChat articles or messy pages, it probes first, falls back to MinerU, and returns a.
desc_en: Robust URL-to-Markdown extraction for OpenClaw workflows. Use when the user wants to "extract/summarize/convert a webpage to markdown" (especially WeChat mp.weixin.qq.com) and web_fetch/browser is blocked or messy. Uses a cheap probe via web_fetch first, then falls back to the official MinerU API (via the local mineru-extract skill) and returns a traceable result contract with source links.
why_zh: 不是硬抓，而是先花小成本探路，确认失败才升级到 MinerU；结果自带来源契约，你永远知道每段文字从哪。
why_en: It probes cheaply first, escalates to MinerU only when needed, and wraps output in a traceable contract—so every line has a.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 URL 转 Markdown 这一格；需要本机已装 mineru-extract 技能，且 MinerU 对图。
limit_en: Only URL-to-Markdown; requires local mineru-extract skill; fails on image-PDFs or heavy CAPTCHAs; output is plain Markdown, no interactive or layout.
